cells.gaps: No regulation or decree applying the law, and no rule made under it that others must check identity against the system, dated in the last three years, is held.
cells.note: Rebuild 2026-10-31: Lei 4/09 as amended in 2017 and 2021 gives a unique citizen number on a chip card (AGO-002, AGO-004); the April 2026 replacement bill does not lower it, and no rule since September 2023 is held. Stage 4 holds.
